display_fil: Kaso: May bilog na makating pantal si Ana
display_en: Case: Ana has an itchy circular rash
narration_fil: May bilog na makating pantal si Ana. May halamang tinatawag niyang Akapulko sa bakuran.
narration_en: Ana has an itchy circular rash. A yard plant is called Akapulko.

narration_fil: Sa reference card, hanapin ang Senna alata. Ang nakalistang bahagi ay dahon; ang paksang gamit ay buni o ibang fungal na problema sa balat. Sabihin kung ano ang alam at hindi alam. Itanong ang kasalukuyang gamot at sintomas. Kung lumalala, kumakalat, may impeksiyon o hindi tiyak ang diagnosis, ipasuri sa health center.
narration_en: Find Senna alata on the reference card. The listed part is leaves; the use topic is ringworm or another fungal skin concern. State what is known and unknown. Ask about current medicine and symptoms. Seek health-center assessment if the rash worsens, spreads, looks infected or the diagnosis is uncertain.

Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Akapulko ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Akapulko part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng halaman sa bakuran ni Ana, kahit hindi pa kumpirmadong Akapulko.
options.en: Any part of Ana’s yard plant, even before it is confirmed as Akapulko.

options.fil: Ang bahaging laging ginagamit ng pamilya, nang hindi tinitingnan ang card.
options.en: The part her family always used, without checking the card.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi pa kumpirmadong Senna alata ang halaman ni Ana, kaya walang bahaging maitutugma. 2: Dahon ng Senna alata ang nasa card; hindi ito dose. 3: Hindi patunay ng halaman o bahagi ang nakasanayan ng pamilya; tingnan ang botanical name.
check.feedback_en: 1: Ana’s yard plant is not yet confirmed as Senna alata, so no part can be matched. 2: The card lists leaves of Senna alata; this is not a dose. 3: Family habit does not confirm the plant or part; check the botanical name.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Card: Senna alata, dahon.
Halaman sa bakuran: hindi pa kumpirmado.
Pantal: hindi dinidiyagnos ng BHW.
Susunod: ipasuri sa health center.
display_en:
Card: Senna alata, leaves.
Yard plant: not yet confirmed.
Rash: not diagnosed by the BHW.
Next: health-center assessment.
narration_fil: Ipinakita ng BHW kay Ana ang card: Senna alata ang Akapulko, at dahon ang nakalistang bahagi. Sinabi ng BHW na hindi pa kumpirmado ang halaman sa bakuran at hindi pa tiyak kung ano ang pantal. Itinanong niya ang gamot at sintomas ni Ana. Dahil hindi tiyak ang diagnosis, ipinasuri niya ang pantal sa health center.
narration_en: The BHW shows Ana the card: Akapulko is Senna alata, and the listed part is leaves. The BHW says the yard plant is not yet confirmed and the rash is not yet diagnosed. The BHW asks about her medicines and symptoms. Because the diagnosis is uncertain, the BHW asks Ana to have the rash assessed at the health center.

display_fil:
Pangalan o larawan: hindi patunay.
Huwag ipahid ang hindi kumpirmadong katas.
Walang paghahanda o dose.
display_en:
Name or picture: not proof.
Do not apply an unverified extract.
No preparation or dosing.
narration_fil: Hindi sapat ang lokal na pangalan o larawan para sa tiyak na pagkilala. Huwag ipahid ang hindi nakumpirmang katas. Hindi awtorisasyon ang lesson na ito para maghanda o mag-dose ng halamang gamot.
narration_en: A local name or picture alone cannot confirm identity. Do not apply an unverified extract. This lesson does not authorize preparation or dosing of an herbal remedy.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang ligtas na tugon sa kaso ni Ana?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe response in Ana’s case?

options.fil: Sabihing buni ito at ipahid kay Ana ang dahon ng halaman sa bakuran.
options.en: Tell Ana it is ringworm and have her apply leaves from the yard plant.

options.fil: Sabihin ang hindi pa alam at ipasuri ang pantal sa health center.
options.en: Say what is unknown and have the health center assess the rash.

options.fil: Ituro ang timpla ng inyong pamilya para hindi na siya magpatingin.
options.en: Show her how your family prepared Akapulko, to save her a trip.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi nagdidiyagnos ang BHW, at hindi kumpirmado ang halaman; huwag itong ipahid. 2: Hindi tiyak ang diagnosis, kaya sa health center ipasusuri ang pantal. 3: Walang pahintulot ang lesson na maghanda, at hindi masusuri ng timpla ang pantal.
check.feedback_en: 1: The BHW does not diagnose, and the yard plant is unverified; do not apply it. 2: The diagnosis is uncertain, so the health center assesses the rash. 3: This lesson does not authorize preparation, and a recipe cannot assess her rash.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ihambing ang dalawang card na may pangalang Akapulko. Markahan ang botanical name, dahon, nakalistang gamit at referral. Ipasuri ang card sa supervisor.
narration_en: On Monday, compare two cards labelled Akapulko. Mark the botanical name, leaves, listed use and referral. Review the card with a supervisor.
